title: Simply Logical -- The First Three Decades
abstract: arXiv:2610.28912v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper charts the evolution of the Prolog textbook Simply Logical -- Intelligent Reasoning by Example from print with runnable programmes on a 3.5-inch diskette published in 1994, via various intermediate online versions, to the fully interactive online edition available today. Our aim is to investigate -- from both the writer's and the reader's perspectives -- the potential impact of technology on educational materials. The three authors of this paper present three distinct and complementary points of view, which come together to shape an interactive online book that offers an immersive learning experience. Peter describes the philosophy behind the original book and experiences teaching from it. Jan demonstrates how contemporary web programming has enabled a fully interactive realisation of the book's philosophy. translated_abstract: 本文追溯了Prolog教科书《Simply Logical——通过示例进行智能推理》的演变历程：从1994年出版的附带3.5英寸软盘可运行程序的印刷版，经过各种中间在线版本，发展至今日的完全交互式在线版本。我们的目的是从作者和读者两个视角调查技术对教育材料的潜在影响。本文的三位作者提出了三种不同且互补的观点，这些观点共同塑造了一本提供沉浸式学习体验的交互式在线书籍。Peter描述了原书背后的设计哲学以及使用该书教学的经历。Jan展示了当代Web编程技术如何实现该书理念的完全交互式呈现。Kacper报告了如何采用不同的技术构建一个多功能的创作工具包，以支持交互式内容的基础架构。
tldr: 本文回顾了Prolog教科书《Simply Logical》从1994年印刷版到完全交互式在线版的演变历程，从作者与读者双重视角探讨了技术发展对教育材料的深远影响。
en_tdlr: This paper traces the three-decade evolution of the Prolog textbook "Simply Logical" from its 1994 print edition to a fully interactive online book, examining the impact of technology on educational materials from both writers' and readers' perspectives.
